# Container package source access

Reviewed 2026-10-27 for the digest-pinned Debian and Python bases in the Dockerfiles.
The TSV inventories record every installed Debian binary and its corresponding
source package/version, separately for both image types and architectures.
No operating-system packages are installed or modified by the project Dockerfiles.

Original package copyright files are retained under `/usr/share/doc/`; standard
license texts remain under `/usr/share/common-licenses/`. Python's license remains
under `/usr/local/lib/python3.13/LICENSE.txt`; pip's vendored notices and each
installed wheel's notices remain in their dist-info directories.
Do not strip these paths when repackaging either image.

Each source record below was checked against Debian Snapshot's source API.
The archive links identify all parts of the corresponding source package, including
its signed .dsc description, upstream tarball(s), and Debian packaging patches.
Snapshot file identifiers are Debian's content SHA-1 identifiers. Download the
complete set for each package and verify the stronger hashes in its .dsc file
before rebuilding or redistributing corresponding source.

For binary image publication, retain these inventories with the image and provide
recipients access to the complete corresponding source alongside the binary image
under the applicable GPL/LGPL/MPL terms. The links identify exact reviewed upstream
sources; they do not constitute a maintainer's written source offer.
When publishing separate source archives, mirror the complete source sets from
these records, plus the Python and native dependency sources listed below, and
publish their locations beside the image download. This implementation does not
publish images or source archives or make an offer on the maintainer's behalf.

Additional source and notice locations:

- Python 3.13.18: https://www.python.org/ftp/python/3.13.18/Python-3.13.18.tar.xz
- Downloader Python packages: exact versions and artifact hashes are in
  `docker/model-download-requirements.txt`. Unmodified Python source and original
  licenses remain in the image. Source distributions are available at
  `https://pypi.org/project/NAME/VERSION/#files`. The pinned Python base supplies
  pip 26.2.2 and retains its vendored notices.
- Native hf-xet: [dependency/source inventory](../hf-xet/DEPENDENCIES.md), upstream
  Cargo.lock checksums, [original notices](../hf-xet/LICENSES.txt), and matching Rust notices.
- Go, ONNX Runtime, and tokenizer: [project notices](../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)
  and the pinned source/version inventories linked there.

Model files are downloaded separately. The router source license does not replace
model terms. When redistributing weights, include the Apache-2.0 text and model
attribution from THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md with the unchanged model bundle.
No standalone binary or model release bundle is produced by the container setup.
